```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r Step 1: Pull in Census Data, include=TRUE}
cbsa_area <- read_delim("2024_Gaz_cbsa_national.txt", 
    delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
    trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
    rename(GEOID = GEOID,
           land_area_sqkm = ALAND_SQMI) %>%
    mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID))
  

years <- c(2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

vars <- c(
  population = "B01003_001",
  med_income = "B19013_001",
  med_rent   = "B25064_001",
  med_value  = "B25077_001"
)

get_one_year <- function(year) {

  message(paste("Pulling year:", year))

  df <- get_acs(
    geography = "metropolitan statistical area/micropolitan statistical area",
    variables = vars,
    year = year,
    survey = "acs5",
    cache_table = TRUE
  ) %>%
    select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

  # Merge land area
  df <- df %>%
    left_join(cbsa_area, by = "GEOID") %>%
    mutate(
      density = population / land_area_sqkm,
      year = year
    )

  return(df)
}

agglo_data <- map_dfr(years, get_one_year)

agglo_data <- agglo_data %>%
  select(-NAME.x)

agglo_data <- agglo_data%>%
  rename(NAME = NAME.y)

agglo_data <- agglo_data %>%
  relocate(NAME)

setdiff(unique(agglo_data$GEOID), unique(cbsa_area$GEOID))

length(unique(agglo_data$GEOID))  # before
length(unique(agglo_data %>% filter(GEOID %in% cbsa_area$GEOID) %>% pull(GEOID)))

agglo_data <- agglo_data %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% cbsa_area$GEOID)

agglo_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_metros = n_distinct(GEOID))

balanced_cbsa <- agglo_data %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year)) %>%
  filter(n_years == length(unique(agglo_data$year))) %>%
  pull(GEOID)

agglo_balanced <- agglo_data %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% balanced_cbsa)

agglo_balanced %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_metros = n_distinct(GEOID))

agglo_balanced <- agglo_balanced %>%
  mutate(
    log_density = log(density),
    log_income  = log(med_income)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    agglo_index = scale(log_density) + scale(log_income)
  )

```

```{r Step 2: Census Data Cost Burden Pull, include=TRUE}
rent_vars <- c(
  total_renters = "B25070_001",
  burdened_30_34 = "B25070_007",
  burdened_35_39 = "B25070_008",
  burdened_40_49 = "B25070_009",
  burdened_50_plus = "B25070_010"
)

get_rent_burden <- function(year) {

  df <- get_acs(
    geography = "metropolitan statistical area/micropolitan statistical area",
    variables = rent_vars,
    year = year,
    survey = "acs5"
  ) %>%
    select(GEOID, variable, estimate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

  df %>%
    mutate(
      cost_burdened = (burdened_30_34 + burdened_35_39 +
                       burdened_40_49 + burdened_50_plus) / total_renters,
      year = year
    )
}

rent_data <- map_dfr(years, get_rent_burden)

```

```{r Step 3: Merge Data for Table, include=TRUE}
analysis_data <- agglo_balanced %>%
  left_join(rent_data, by = c("GEOID", "year"))

pr_cbsa_codes <- c("10380", "17620", "25020", "27580", "32420", "41900", "42180", "47894", "49500")

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(!GEOID %in% pr_cbsa_codes)

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(agglo_index = as.numeric(agglo_index))

write_csv(analysis_data, here("01_tidydata", "metrotabledata.csv"))

```

```{r Step 4: Create Table, include=TRUE}
top10 <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  arrange(desc(agglo_index)) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  select(NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened, med_rent) %>%
  mutate(
    cost_burdened = scales::percent(cost_burdened, 0.1),
    med_rent = scales::dollar(med_rent)
  )

bottom10 <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  arrange(agglo_index) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  select(NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened, med_rent) %>%
  mutate(
    cost_burdened = scales::percent(cost_burdened, 0.1),
    med_rent = scales::dollar(med_rent)
  )

agglo_table <- bind_rows(
  top10 %>% mutate(group = "Top 10"),
  bottom10 %>% mutate(group = "Bottom 10")
)

#Add in Change in Burden Proportion
cb_change <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2010, 2024)) %>%
  select(GEOID, NAME, year, cost_burdened) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = cost_burdened
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change_cb = `2024` - `2010`
  ) %>%
  select(GEOID, change_cb)

cbsa_2024 <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  left_join(cb_change, by = "GEOID")

top10 <- cbsa_2024 %>%
  arrange(desc(agglo_index)) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  select(NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened, change_cb, med_rent)

bottom10 <- cbsa_2024 %>%
  arrange(agglo_index) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  select(NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened, change_cb, med_rent)

agglo_table <- bind_rows(
  top10 %>% mutate(group = "Top 10"),
  bottom10 %>% mutate(group = "Bottom 10")
)

agglo_table %>%
  mutate(
    agglo_index = round(agglo_index, 2),
    cost_burdened = scales::percent(cost_burdened, accuracy = 0.1),
    change_cb = scales::percent(change_cb, accuracy = 0.1),
    med_rent = scales::dollar(med_rent)
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, desc(agglo_index))

agglo_table %>%
  select(group, NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened, change_cb, med_rent)

agglo_table <- agglo_table %>%
  mutate(
    change_cb_num = change_cb,   # keep numeric
    cost_burdened_num = cost_burdened
  )

agglo_table

```

```{r Step 5: Format Table, include=TRUE}
# Create the formatted table
table_data <- agglo_table %>%
  mutate(
    agglo_index = round(agglo_index, 2),
    cost_burdened_formatted = scales::percent(cost_burdened, accuracy = 0.1),
    change_cb_formatted = scales::percent(change_cb, accuracy = 0.1),
    med_rent_formatted = scales::dollar(med_rent)
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(group, levels = c("Top 10", "Bottom 10")), desc(agglo_index)) %>%
  select(group, NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened_formatted, change_cb_formatted, med_rent_formatted, change_cb)

# Apply conditional coloring to the change column
table_data$change_cb_colored <- cell_spec(
  table_data$change_cb_formatted,
  color = ifelse(table_data$change_cb < 0, "#2E8B57", "#CD5C5C"),  # Green for negative, red for positive
  bold = TRUE
)

# Create the final table
final_table <- table_data %>%
  select(group, NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened_formatted, change_cb_colored, med_rent_formatted) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Ranking", "Metropolitan Area", "Agglomeration Index", 
                  "Cost Burdened (%)", "Change in Burden (2010-2024)", "Median Rent"),
    escape = FALSE,  # Important: allows HTML formatting
    format = "html"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  pack_rows("Top 10 Metro Areas", 1, 10, label_row_css = "background-color: #E8F5E8; color: #2E8B57; font-weight: bold;") %>%
  pack_rows("Bottom 10 Metro Areas", 11, 20, label_row_css = "background-color: #FFE8E8; color: #CD5C5C; font-weight: bold;")

final_table

# Save as PNG image
final_table %>%
  save_kable("final_table.png")
```
